svg.title: AIcoach — Upload on the phone, card stack
svg.text: At the range, one card at a time
Phone flow. The coach asks for one swing, the stack fills in while it watches, and every card opens where it sits.

text.tspan: Send me one swing, filmed down the line.

g.text: 120 fps if your phone has it

text.tspan: Off. If on, the clip is stored on the
AIcoach server until you delete it.

g.text: mp4 or mov · max 15 s · from Photos or Files
Opens when the result is ready
Usually under a minute. You can put the phone down.

text.tspan: Your hips move toward the ball
extension, and I’m sure of it.

g.text: Ask why. I answer from this swing.

text.tspan: Ask me about this swing. I answer
only from what I measured here.

How do I know the drill is working?

svg.text: The checklist is the coach’s first card. One action, in thumb reach.
The stack fills in as it watches. Cards not yet earned stay dashed.
The first card is open. The rest wait as one line each.
Earlier cards fold to a line. The chat takes the screen.
